currentRoundInspection.method: Inspected exterior picture pixels and standard viewer PMTiles.
currentRoundInspection.placement: Inspected skyline and close exterior pictures confirm the three concrete shafts, inclined supports, ruby/pale principal spheres and triangulated shells. The close picture shows three small pale joint spheres partway up the inclined supports; browser derivatives move them from the old entry-foot positions to approximate42m support-joint locations with4.4m radii. Original detailed source remains reproducible. Retain468m height, eleven spheres, authored main sphere heights and the corrected mapped center/alternating shaft-brace phase. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the tower and plaza context. Off-footprint PMTiles point[-80,0]11.7337m sets approximate ground contact; center34.2199m contains coarse urban imprint. Bounded preview contacts preserve raw samples separately. Exact joint-sphere positions, shell fabrication, hotel pearl layout, shaft connections, maintenance equipment and entrance thresholds remain approximations; wider exhibition complex excluded.
